title: Iceberg Rust / pyiceberg-core 0.10.1
summary: Danny Jones reported that the pyiceberg-core release artifacts for 0.10.0 were wrong: they were built from the main branch instead of the 0.10.0 release, and have been yanked after Vova Kot pointed out the problem. The plan is a 0.10.1 release with zero changes, simply a new set of artifacts targeting the right branch, to be published soon; a tracking issue was opened in iceberg-rust. kevinjqliu confirmed he yanked pyiceberg-core 0.10.0 from PyPI because it contained code that was not part of the 0.10.0 release, and suggested starting the 0.10.1 release from the same commit hash as 0.10.0 with a vote thread. liurenjie1024 said the cause was his manual publishing of pyiceberg-core from the wrong branch. No objections to the plan were raised.

positions.stance: Run a 0.10.1 release with zero changes to republish artifacts from the right branch, as soon as possible.
pyiceberg-core 0.10.0 was yanked from PyPI; start 0.10.1 from the same commit hash as 0.10.0 and open a vote thread.
The wrong artifacts resulted from manually publishing pyiceberg-core from the wrong branch.

outcome.note: No objections to a no-change 0.10.1 release from the 0.10.0 commit; pyiceberg-core 0.10.0 was yanked from PyPI. The vote is to happen in a separate thread.

why_it_matters: pyiceberg-core 0.10.0 on PyPI was yanked because it was built from main, so users need 0.10.1 instead.
